card.name: Linking words before trial and patient counts
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, of, all, the, more, additional, adult) just before a trial description or patient numbers in adverse-reaction and trial-results text.

modes.label: Reporting phrase
modes.description: Words like in or of after 'were reported' or 'loss', leading to a percentage or trial.
modes.example: Injection site reactions were reported<< in>> 73% of patients receiving AP
